newsitem.title: USA: Dominguez Services Corp Q1 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Dominguez Services Corp Q1 net rises.

text.p: Dominguez Services Corp Tuesday reported first quarter net income of $282,469, equal to 28 cents per share, an increase of four percent from $270,469, or 27 cents per share, a year ago. For the three months ended March 31, 1997, revenues fell $5,168,027 from $5,225,268 in the prior year period.

Mr. Brady also announced the signing of letters of intent to acquire two water companies adjacent to its Kern River Valley system. These acquisitions will add approximately 570 new customers, and will bring to about 4,000 the total number of customers served in the region. Upon consummation of the transactions, the Company will serve a total of approximately 38,000 customers across the South Bay, Antelope Valley and Kern River Valley regions of California.
